title: A fiber-functor comparison induces the geometric stalk comparison
statement: Let S and p be as in [lem-trf-etale-topos-point-fiber-comparison], and fix an algebraically closed field Ω:Type u and geometric point s:Spec Ω→S [def-weil-geometric-point]. Suppose L(U)=p.inverse(h_U^#) is naturally isomorphic to the geometric lift functor Hom_S(Spec Ω,U), lifted to Type (u+1). Then p.inverse is naturally isomorphic to the actual geometric sheaf fiber functor (pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber. This is a conditional extension theorem; it supplies no geometric point or fiber comparison.

proof.text: For the Mathlib point Φ=pointSmallEtale(s), identify uliftYoneda followed by Φ.presheafFiber with Φ.fiber followed by uliftFunctor. The private helper geometricRepresentableFiberIso uses shrinkYonedaIsoYoneda, presheafFiberCompIso for uliftFunctor, and shrinkYonedaCompPresheafFiberIso; all are proved Mathlib isomorphisms.

proof.text: Let P be sheafification followed by p.inverse and Q the geometric presheaf fiber. Both are left adjoints, the latter by the skyscraper-presheaf adjunction. The given isomorphism and the preceding comparison identify their restrictions along uliftYoneda. Apply CategoryTheory.Presheaf.uniqueExtensionAlongULiftYoneda twice, using that they preserve colimits, to obtain P≅Q.

proof.text: Sheafification is a localization at the maps inverted by sheaves. Its composites with p.inverse and the geometric sheaf fiber lift P and Q respectively; for Q this is Mathlib point.presheafToSheafCompSheafFiberIso. Localization.liftNatIso gives the claimed isomorphism on sheaves. No generic site_point_reconstruction_sets or geometricStalkToposPoint theorem is used.

theorem etale_point_fiber_iso_to_stalk
    (S : Scheme.{u})
    (p : GeometricMorphism (Type (u + 1))
      (Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))))
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S)
    (h : Nonempty (etalePointFiberFunctor S p ≅
      ((pointSmallEtale s).fiber ⋙ CategoryTheory.uliftFunctor.{u + 1}))) :
    Nonempty (p.inverse ≅ (pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber (A := Type (u + 1)))
